name: highlighter

frames.best_why: All three strokes are fully drawn: yellow wash, cyan underline and purple box, none cut off.

tagline: Words get a hand-drawn marker wash, wavy underline or shaky box.
summary: Wraps a phrase so a rough, hand-drawn stroke draws over it: a highlighter wash, an underline, a box and other styles, each in a colour you choose.
appearance: Two lines of white text on black. On the first, a pale yellow band with torn, uneven edges sits behind the words "highlighted text" and overhangs them slightly. On the second, "underline mode" carries a wavy cyan rule and "box style" is enclosed in a shaky purple rectangle.
behaviour: Once the wrapped text is on screen, the chosen stroke draws itself on over less than a second in two passes, leaving a marker-like uneven edge. It redraws if the text changes size.
demo_content: Sentences reading "The highlighted text draws across on view" and "Switch to underline mode or box style for variety"
search_phrases: rough sketch box around a phrase
use_when: A few words in a headline need emphasis that looks drawn by hand rather than printed.
avoid_when: Dense body text or many marked phrases, where repeated rough strokes become noisy and slow to read.
customise: The phrase is children; the action (highlight, underline, box, circle, strike-through and more), colour, stroke width, draw time, passes, padding and multiline are props.
weight_why: A few SVG paths per phrase that draw once, then sit idle.

a11y.note: The strokes are decorative, but the draw animation ignores reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: The hand-drawn strokes read convincingly and stay legible; edge alignment varies slightly per pass.
